Jokes aside, I am looking for someone who has programming and graphic design skills. I know Python (I am learning it currently), C#, Java, CSS, HTML, JavaScript, Kotlin, and C, so if y'all know any of these, that's a plus!
summary:
TERRA-ATLS GLOBAL is an advanced, interactive planetary analog discovery engine designed for the NASA Space Apps Challenge.

What We Developed: A high-performance web application featuring a Leaflet.js 4K satellite and topographic mapping engine, bilingual (English/Arabic) AI search, and a HUD telemetry drawer that provides live similarity indices, operational risk scores, and custom SVG elevation profiles for 15 previously unrecognized terrestrial analog sites across six continents.

How It Addresses the Challenge: It connects Earth with space by cross-correlating multi-spectral NASA Earth observation data with lunar and Martian orbital telemetry, allowing researchers to instantly discover and evaluate diverse terrestrial environments matching specific extraterrestrial targets.

Why It Is Important: Because testing space hardware directly on other planets is unfeasible, mission planners rely heavily on Earth analogs. TERRA-ATLAS GLOBAL equips scientists and Artemis mission teams with precise environmental, safety, and hardware recommendations, enabling safe, efficient, and rigorous space mission simulations right here on Earth.
details:
1. What It Does & How It Works TERRA-ATLAS GLOBAL is an interactive planetary analog discovery engine that bridges Earth geology with extraterrestrial exploration.
  • The Engine: Built around an interactive global map interface, it maps 15 previously unrecognized terrestrial analog sites across six continents directly to specific lunar and Martian target sites (such as Jezero Crater or Marius Hills).
  • How It Works: Users can navigate a 4K satellite and terrain map, execute natural language searches in both English and Arabic, apply category filters (Moon, Mars, or global regions), and click on interactive radar pins. Clicking any site opens a live NASA HUD Telemetry Drawer displaying GPS coordinates, elevations, surface temperatures, planetary similarity percentages, operational risk scores, and dynamic SVG topographic elevation profiles.
  1. Benefits
  • Expands Mission Options: Moves beyond heavily studied, cliché analog sites (like the Atacama or Mojave) to offer fresh, uncharacterized field options.
  • Data-Driven Decision Making: Delivers instant access to operational risk indices, local population data, environmental factors, and recommended NASA test hardware for each site.
  • Seamless Accessibility: Features a lightweight, single-file frontend architecture with zero restricted API watermarks, ensuring fast loading and flawless performance on any browser.
  1. Intended Impact Because testing space hardware directly on the Moon or Mars is unfeasible, space agencies rely heavily on Earth-based simulations. The intended impact of TERRA-ATLAS GLOBAL is to equip scientists, researchers, and Artemis mission planners with precise environmental and safety data.This enables teams to run rigorous, safe, and efficient field tests for rovers, suits, and habitats right here on Earth.
  2. Tools, Coding Languages & Software Used
  • Languages: HTML5 (UI structure and DOM layout), CSS3 / Tailwind CSS via CDN (glassmorphism, futuristic dark-mode aerospace aesthetic #071324), and JavaScript (core interactive logic, data filtering, and UI rendering).
  • Mapping Framework: Leaflet.js for high-performance rendering, custom GPS coordinate mapping, and smooth camera animations (flyTo and fitBounds).
  • Tile Layers & Data Sources: Esri World Imagery (4K Satellite) and OpenTopoMap (Elevation & Terrain), integrated with multi-spectral NASA Earth observation and orbital datasets (Landsat, SRTM, LRO LOLA/Diviner, MRO CRISM).
  • Environment: Developed on Windows PC utilizing modern code editors and browser debugging tools.
  1. Creative Elements
  • Bilingual AI Search Experience: Supports seamless cross-lingual querying, allowing users to search using English terminology (e.g., "lunar lava tubes") or Arabic text (e.g., "كهوف القمر", "الكويت") with instant autocomplete and filtering.
  • NASA Mission Control Aesthetic: Combines a deep ocean tactical backdrop (#071324), frosted glassmorphic panels (backdrop-blur), and glowing radar pulse animations that evoke a real-time spacecraft command deck.
  • Dynamic Topographic Cross-Sections: Dynamically generates custom SVG elevation profile curves on the fly for each site, giving judges an immediate visual sense of local ridges, craters, and depressions.
  1. Key Factors Considered
  • User Experience & Performance: Eliminated white flashing during map pans by locking the deep ocean background color and utilizing strict coordinate boundaries (maxBounds) to prevent infinite dragging.
  • Visual Clarity: Designed glowing radar markers with transparent fills so that underlying 4K satellite imagery and terrain contours remain completely crisp and readable.
  • Scientific Rigor & Transparency: Explicitly included a mandatory Earth Limitations Disclosure protocol for every site, reminding mission planners where terrestrial analogies break down (such as Earth's 1G gravity vs. lunar/Martian low gravity, and atmospheric differences).
